title: Asymptotic condition numbers for linear ordinary differential equations: the generic real case
summary: The paper \cite{M0} studied, for a \emph{complex} linear ordinary differential equation $y^\prime(t)=Ay(t)$, the long-time propagation to the solution $y(t)$ of a perturbation of the initial value. By measuring the perturbations with relative errors, this paper introduced a directional pointwise condition number, defined for a specific initial value and for a specific direction of perturbation of this initial value, and a pointwise condition number, defined for a specific initial value and the worst-case scenario for the direction of perturbation.
